description:
沙箱终止统计。**数据源：ClickHouse `sandbox_events`**（2026-09-22 从 Loki 切过来，旧查询留在脚本注释里）。
默认 24h。
⚠️ **稀有原因是阵发的，靠调窗口看不见** —— 实测 orphaned 的 614 条全落在 09-16~18，单小时峰值 311，之后四天为 0；24h 窗口下是 0。所以「稀有原因」那一行**固定查满 7 天（TTL 上限）、不跟随时间选择器**，那一行为空才代表真的没发生过。
CH 独有：沙箱存活时长（execution_time，timeout 的 p50 正好贴 TTL 档位）、业务标签（sandbox_metadata，覆盖率 99.1%）。
六种原因固定全列显示（countIf 出的列，为 0 也在）

panels.title: unknown
稀有原因（固定最近 7 天，不随时间选择器）

panels.description:
**固定查最近 7 天**（TTL 上限），不跟随上方的时间选择器 —— 稀有原因是阵发的，滚动窗口很容易恰好错过。
只列 admin / orphaned / base_template_missing / unknown 四种；request 和 timeout 是正常生命周期，不在这里。
**这个表为空 = 最近 7 天真的没发生过**，是有意义的结论；
有行则点进「明细下钻」按那天的时间范围查具体沙箱

targets.rawSql:
SELECT toString(toDate(timestamp)) AS day,
  count() AS total,
  countIf(JSONExtractString(coalesce(event_data, '{}'),'kill_reason') = 'admin') AS admin,
  countIf(JSONExtractString(coalesce(event_data, '{}'),'kill_reason') = 'orphaned') AS orphaned,
  countIf(JSONExtractString(coalesce(event_data, '{}'),'kill_reason') = 'base_template_missing') AS base_template_missing,
  countIf(JSONExtractString(coalesce(event_data, '{}'),'kill_reason') = 'unknown') AS unknown
FROM sandbox_events
WHERE (type = 'sandbox.lifecycle.killed' OR (event_category = 'lifecycle' AND event_label = 'kill'))
  AND timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 7 DAY
  AND JSONExtractString(coalesce(event_data, '{}'),'kill_reason') IN ('admin', 'orphaned', 'base_template_missing', 'unknown')
  AND match(toString(sandbox_team_id), '$teamID')
GROUP BY day ORDER BY day DESC

panels.title: 四种稀有原因按天（固定 7d）

panels.description:
同样固定 7 天。带首次/末次出现时间，用来判断是「一次性爆发」还是「持续发生」。
实测 orphaned 涉及 6 个 team，是系统性事件而非单 team 问题 —— 如果只有一个 team 那更可能是调用方的用法问题

targets.rawSql:
SELECT toString(sandbox_team_id) AS team,
  JSONExtractString(coalesce(event_data, '{}'),'kill_reason') AS reason,
  count() AS cnt,
  toString(min(timestamp)) AS first_seen,
  toString(max(timestamp)) AS last_seen
FROM sandbox_events
WHERE (type = 'sandbox.lifecycle.killed' OR (event_category = 'lifecycle' AND event_label = 'kill'))
  AND timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 7 DAY
  AND JSONExtractString(coalesce(event_data, '{}'),'kill_reason') IN ('admin', 'orphaned', 'base_template_missing', 'unknown')
  AND match(toString(sandbox_team_id), '$teamID')
GROUP BY team, reason ORDER BY cnt DESC LIMIT 15

panels.title: 特殊原因被 kill 的沙箱明细（admin/orphaned/base_template_missing/unknown）

panels.description:
一根柱子 = 一个 team，按 kill 原因堆叠。
绿 request（用户主动）、蓝 timeout（TTL 到期）都正常；
橙 admin、红 orphaned、紫 base_template_missing 值得查

targets.rawSql:
SELECT toString(sandbox_team_id) AS team,
  JSONExtractString(coalesce(event_data, '{}'),'kill_reason') AS reason, count() AS cnt
FROM sandbox_events WHERE (type = 'sandbox.lifecycle.killed' OR (event_category = 'lifecycle' AND event_label = 'kill')) AND timestamp >= $__fromTime AND timestamp <= $__toTime AND match(toString(sandbox_team_id), '$teamID')
GROUP BY team, reason ORDER BY cnt DESC

按总数降序

targets.rawSql:
SELECT toString(sandbox_team_id) AS team,
  count() AS total,
  countIf(JSONExtractString(coalesce(event_data, '{}'),'kill_reason') = 'request') AS request,
  countIf(JSONExtractString(coalesce(event_data, '{}'),'kill_reason') = 'timeout') AS timeout,
  countIf(JSONExtractString(coalesce(event_data, '{}'),'kill_reason') = 'admin') AS admin,
  countIf(JSONExtractString(coalesce(event_data, '{}'),'kill_reason') = 'orphaned') AS orphaned,
  countIf(JSONExtractString(coalesce(event_data, '{}'),'kill_reason') = 'base_template_missing') AS base_template_missing,
  countIf(JSONExtractString(coalesce(event_data, '{}'),'kill_reason') = 'unknown') AS unknown
FROM sandbox_events WHERE (type = 'sandbox.lifecycle.killed' OR (event_category = 'lifecycle' AND event_label = 'kill')) AND timestamp >= $__fromTime AND timestamp <= $__toTime AND match(toString(sandbox_team_id), '$teamID')
GROUP BY team ORDER BY total DESC
